cas:Entity.dcterms:title: Package
cas:Entity.skos:definition: A CASCaRA meta-model item used for packages comprising entities, relationships and potentially nested packages, both classes and instances.

cas:Entity.dcterms:title: Organizer
cas:Entity.skos:definition: An element organizing model elements. An example is a list of requirements or a diagram using a certain notation.

cas:Entity.dcterms:title: Hierarchy Root
cas:Entity.skos:definition: A subclass of CASCaRA organizer serving as a root for hierarchically organized graph elements.

cas:Entity.dcterms:title: Outline
cas:Entity.skos:definition: A subclass of CASCaRA organizer comprising all information items of a human-readable document. As usual, the outline is hierarchically organized.

cas:Entity.dcterms:title: View
cas:Entity.skos:definition: A subclass of CASCaRA organizer representing a model view (diagram) using a certain notation showing selected model elements.

cas:Property.dcterms:title: has category
cas:Property.skos:definition: Specifies a category for an element (entity, relationship or organizer).

cas:Link.dcterms:title: to source
cas:Link.skos:definition: Connects the source of a reified relationship.

cas:Link.dcterms:title: to target
cas:Link.skos:definition: Connects the target of a reified relationship or an organizer.

cas:Link.dcterms:title: lists
cas:Link.skos:definition: Lists an entity, a relationship or a subordinated organizer.

cas:Link.dcterms:title: shows
cas:Link.skos:definition: Shows an entity or a relationship.

cas:Link.dcterms:title: depicts
cas:Link.skos:definition: Depicts an entity; inverse of uml:ownedDiagram.
